guest.intro_title: Someone shared a collection with you
guest.intro_desc: You're viewing this collection over a live, private WebRTC link. Nothing is downloaded — media streams from the owner's device and is cleared when the session ends.
guest.intro_note: By continuing you agree this content stays between you and the owner.
guest.upsell_desc: You're browsing a collection shared by a Siegu owner through a live, private link. Nothing you see is downloaded — media streams straight from their device.
guest.upsell_feature_1: All your photos and videos, on every device
guest.upsell_feature_2: Private by design — no photos stored on any server
guest.upsell_feature_3: Built-in sharing and collections, free on your network
guest.upsell_external_desc: siegu.io hosted links let you share outside your network.
guest.share_ended: This shared collection session has ended.
guest.connected: Connected — streamed live from the owner
guest.error: Couldn't connect to this shared collection.

people.name_dialog_hint: Type a new name, or pick an existing person to add these faces to.

devices.title: Devices
devices.desc: Sync and manage your connected devices.
devices.no_devices_desc: Link your mobile devices or other computers to sync and access your media library from anywhere.
devices.no_devices_desc_alt: Link a device using the pairing code to sync your library.
devices.remove_device_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove {name}? This will stop all synchronization with this device.

sync.refresh_files: Scan for new and changed files
sync.stopped_resume: Stopped — resumes where you left off

connect.link_device_desc: Sync your library across your own hardware.
connect.privacy_note: Your data stays on your local network — no third-party servers. Everything stays between your devices.
connect.host_desc: Make your library available to nearby devices
connect.join_desc: Find and connect to a device on your network
connect.same_network_note: Make sure both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
connect.view_only_empty: No items shared by this peer

connect.no_devices_found: No devices found nearby. Open the app on your other device in Share mode.
connect.select_device: Select a device to connect to
connect.connect_fromAnywhere: Connect from anywhere with Internet Sync — coming soon
connect.web_enter_host_hint: LAN discovery is available in the desktop app. Open Siegu on your other device in Share mode, or use its Share link to connect.

albums.title: Collections
albums.no_albums_hint: Create a collection to group your photos and videos
albums.benefit_private: Everything stays private on your device
albums.no_albums_yet: No collections yet — create one above
albums.share_album_subtitle: Share a read-only view of this collection
albums.share_requires_signalling: Sharing collections requires a signalling server to coordinate the secure connection between devices.
albums.share_how_it_desc: Your photos stream directly from your device to the viewer — nothing is stored on any server. The viewer can only see this specific collection, and nothing else from your library.
albums.share_album_desc: Share a read-only link to this collection. Recipients can view the collection in any browser — no app install required.
albums.share_upsell_title: Hosted by you, on your network
albums.share_upsell_desc: This free share works only between devices on your local network. To share with anyone outside your Wi-Fi, use a siegu.io hosted link.
albums.share_timed_hint: The link auto-closes {minutes} minutes after it's created.
albums.share_one_time_hint: One person may join. Sharing stops as soon as they leave.
albums.share_guests_same_network: Guests must be on the same network as this computer.
albums.share_laptop_off_warning: Sharing ends if this computer sleeps, closes Siegu, or disconnects from the network.
albums.share_one_time_ended: The guest left — this one-time share has ended.
albums.delete_confirm: Delete this collection? The photos inside will stay in your library.
albums.search_in_album: Search by name, date, or description...
albums.no_results_in_album: No photos in this collection match "{query}"
albums.empty_album_hint: Open a photo and choose "Add to Collection" to fill it up

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Configure your library and AI preferences
settings.analyze_existing_hint: When turned off, only photos added afterwards are analyzed. Your current library stays unanalyzed until you turn this back on.
settings.cleanup_db_desc: Erase the entire library index and start fresh. Your photo files are not touched.
settings.storage_cap_desc: Limit how much space received photos may use. When the cap is hit, the oldest files you received are replaced with thumbnails; originals stay on the device they came from.
settings.clear_db_desc: This erases all indexed photos, people, albums, faces and settings from the app. Your original photo files are not deleted. Do you want to continue?
settings.clear_db_confirm: This cannot be undone. All your indexed data will be erased.
settings.wipe_desc: This will remove the folder reference and permanently delete all indexed AI data for these files. Your actual photos will not be touched.
settings.wipe_confirm: This cannot be undone. All AI data for this folder will be permanently deleted.
settings.scan_threads_desc: How many photos are analyzed at the same time. More is faster but uses more power.
settings.indexing_when: When does Siegu analyze new photos?
settings.mode_immediate_desc: New photos are analyzed right away.
settings.mode_idle_desc: Analysis is spaced out to use less power.
settings.mode_manual_desc: Nothing runs automatically. Use "Analyze all now" when you want.
settings.indexing_manual_hint: Auto-analysis is off. Use "Analyze all now" when you want.
settings.speed_hint: How fast Siegu works through your photos. Low is gentle on your device, Full uses all your CPU cores.
settings.speed_summary: Currently using {cores} CPU cores per model and analyzing {photos} photos at once.
settings.ai_speed_applied: AI speed set to {cores} CPU cores — reloading models…
settings.memory_budget_applied: Memory limit set to {size} — reloading models…
settings.models_reloaded: AI models reloaded with the new settings.
settings.scan_threads_applied_hint: Photos analyzed at once set to {count} — applies to the next analysis.
settings.signalling_url_desc: Where devices meet to exchange WebRTC connection info. Use the managed server or your own self-hosted signalling server.
settings.signalling_token_placeholder: Required when your server enforces a token
settings.signalling_reset: Signalling settings reset to the default server
settings.model_reason_low_ram: This device doesn't have enough memory to run this model
settings.model_reason_memory_budget: Exceeds your memory limit — raise the Memory limit in Performance to enable
settings.model_reason_load_failed: Couldn't load on this device — try re-downloading it
settings.performance_desc: Balance speed and resource use. Pick a mode that fits your device.
settings.preset_low_desc: Gentle — best for phones and laptops.
settings.preset_balanced_desc: Good speed with sensible resource use.
settings.preset_full_desc: Fastest — uses all your CPU cores.
settings.ml_threads_desc: How many CPU cores the AI may use. More is faster but uses more power.
settings.batch_delay_desc: Seconds between batches to keep the device cool.
settings.memory_budget_desc: Maximum RAM for AI models. 0 = no limit.
settings.memory_freed: Models unloaded from memory. They reload before the next analysis.
settings.signalling_upsell_desc: A signalling server helps your devices find each other and connect. Without it, both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
settings.signalling_upsell_benefits: Our hosted server removes that restriction — sync over the internet, no router config needed. Requires a Pro plan.
settings.pro_pro_desc: Unlock Pro after your purchase by confirming the email you paid with.
settings.pro_pro_steps: 1) Enter your email. 2) We’ll send a verify link — tap it. 3) Back here, tap “Check status” to unlock Pro.
settings.pro_pro_email_sent: Verification email sent — check your inbox.
settings.pro_pro_email_required: Please enter the email used at checkout.
settings.pro_pro_not_paid: No Pro purchase found for this email yet.
settings.pro_pro_not_verified: Payment found — open the verification link we emailed you.
settings.pro_pro_unlocked: Pro unlocked! Welcome to the family.
settings.pro_pro_upsell_desc: Private, on-device, one price for every device.
settings.pro_steps_short: Enter the email you paid with and tap “Verify Pro” — we’ll send a link and unlock Pro the moment you tap it.
settings.pro_dialog_waiting_desc: We sent a confirmation link to
settings.pro_dialog_watching: Waiting for you to tap the link… it will unlock automatically.

guided_tour.welcome_desc: Your photos are being indexed. Take a quick tour to learn how everything works.
guided_tour.search_desc: Type what you want to find — like 'dog', 'beach', or 'Mom'. AI will search your entire library for you.
guided_tour.library_desc: Your photos show up here as we find them. Each photo can have tags, faces, and a quality score.
guided_tour.scan_button_desc: Tap this button to see scanning progress, the current file being processed, and how many photos are left.
guided_tour.scan_progress_desc: When scanning, you'll see the file name and progress here. 'Discovering' means we're finding new files, 'Indexing' means AI is analyzing them.
guided_tour.people_desc: Siegu finds faces and groups them by person. Come back later after more photos are indexed to see people.
guided_tour.map_desc: Photos with location data appear on a map. Click around to see memories from different places.
guided_tour.devices_desc: Sync your phone or other computers to share photos directly — no cloud needed.
guided_tour.settings_desc: Choose which folders to watch, download AI models, and adjust performance settings.
guided_tour.done_desc: Enjoy Siegu! Your photos are being indexed in the background. Check back often as your library grows.

onboarding.greet_desc: Your private, AI-powered photo library. No cloud, no uploads — just your memories, organized locally.
onboarding.setup_local_desc: Index photos from folders on this computer
onboarding.join_library_desc: Sync with another device on your network
onboarding.ai_disclaimer: AI models run entirely on your device. No data ever leaves your computer.
onboarding.add_media_desc: Choose the folders where Siegu should look for photos and videos.
onboarding.ai_desc: Download the AI models you'd like to use, or skip for now and add them later in Settings. All processing happens on your device.
onboarding.model_info: We recommend downloading at least the core models for the best experience.
onboarding.ai_optional: You can skip this and download models anytime from Settings.
onboarding.sync_desc: Link other computers or phones to keep your library in sync across devices.
onboarding.your_library_desc: Pick the folder with your own photos so they can be backed up to the linked device.
onboarding.ready_desc: Siegu is ready to start indexing your photos. You can adjust settings anytime.
onboarding.scan_desc: Siegu will scan your folders and start indexing. This may take a while depending on your library size.

clip.title: Smart Search
clip.desc: Finds objects and scenes in your photos.

face.title: Face Grouping
face.desc: Finds faces and groups them by person.

ocr.title: Text Finder
ocr.desc: Reads text inside photos like receipts.

aesthetics.title: Quality Scorer
aesthetics.desc: Rates photos by how good they look.
aesthetics.search: Helps you find your best shots quickly.

blip.title: Photo Describer
blip.desc: Writes sentences about what is in photos.

yolo.title: Object Pro
yolo.desc: Pinpoint accuracy for finding specific items.
yolo.search: Adds deep tags for 80+ common objects.

midas.title: Depth Vision
midas.search: Adds depth-based filters to your library.

whisper.title: Audio Search
whisper.search: Search for things people said in videos.

update_desc: Check for new version of Siegu
update_not_supported: Auto-updates aren't supported on this platform. Download the latest version from the Siegu website.
about_licenses_intro: Siegu is built on the following open-source software:

scan.discovering_desc: Finding media files in your folders...
scan.analyzing_desc: Running face detection, object recognition, and more...
scan.paused_desc: Scan is paused. Resume when ready.
scan.can_browse: You can close this and keep browsing while scanning continues.

settings_tour.intro_desc: This is where you control everything: which folders Siegu watches, the AI models it uses, how fast it runs, appearance, backups and more. Press ? here or Next to explore each section.
settings_tour.folders_desc: These are the folders Siegu scans for photos and videos. Anything you add here gets indexed so it appears in your library and search results.
settings_tour.folders_add_desc: Tap Add Folder to include a new location in your library. You can remove a folder later with the menu button, or wipe its indexed data entirely.
settings_tour.ai_desc: Siegu uses on-device AI to understand your photos: faces, objects, text, places and more. Here you manage models and tune how hard the app works.
settings_tour.models_desc: Each model enables a capability (faces, tags, aesthetics, etc.). Download the ones you want, and toggle any downloaded model on or off. Analyze existing photos whenever you like.
settings_tour.indexing_desc: Choose when AI runs: immediately as photos arrive, only when the computer is idle, or manually when you press Analyze Now.
settings_tour.speed_desc: Low, Balanced or Full controls how many cores and how much memory AI uses. Pick Full for the fastest results, or Low if you want to keep the machine responsive.
settings_tour.language_desc: Switch the entire interface between available languages here.
settings_tour.appearance_desc: Choose System, Light or Dark theme to match your preference.
settings_tour.maintenance_desc: Clean up and maintain your library. Clearing the database removes indexed AI data so it can be rebuilt.
settings_tour.logs_desc: Live log output can help diagnose issues. Copy the logs to share them, or clear them from this view.
settings_tour.storage_desc: Set a soft limit on how much this device stores for a synced library, and see how much space is currently used.
settings_tour.signalling_desc: For device-to-device sync, a signalling server helps devices find each other. Set the URL and token, then Test and Save.
settings_tour.update_desc: Check whether a newer version of Siegu is available and download it from here.
settings_tour.about_desc: Version info and the open-source licenses used by Siegu live here.
settings_tour.done_desc: That covers the whole settings page. Browse around — every option is optional and can be changed any time.

duplicates.title: Space saver
duplicates.desc: Find exact, near-identical and visually similar copies, then free up space.
duplicates.no_duplicates_desc: Siegu compares photos by file hash, perceptual hash and CLIP embeddings to group copies. Nothing to clean up right now.
duplicates.unknown_best: No quality score yet — tap a photo to pick the one to keep
duplicates.scanning_hint: The first scan reads every photo to detect duplicates. This can take a few minutes; later scans are instant.
duplicates.scan_done: Space saver: {groups} group(s) found — {size} could be freed
